setup: A chain hangs in the curve y = [[a]] cosh(x/[[a]]).

steps.say: The parameter [[a]] scales the curve and sets its lowest point, because cosh 0 = 1 gives a height of [[a]] at x = 0.
A height comes from substituting the given x into [[a]] cosh(x/[[a]]), so the ratio x over [[a]] decides the factor and [[a]] scales it.
An arc length uses cosh squared minus sinh squared equals 1, which turns the arc element into cosh(x/[[a]]) dx, and its antiderivative is [[a]] sinh(x/[[a]]).
